flop_count_operators: run flop_count_operators on a Detectron2 model with random image inputs to count convolution FLOPs
parameter_count: run parameter_count on a Detectron2 model to get total and per-module parameter counts
find_unused_parameters: run find_unused_parameters on a PyTorch module to identify parameters not used in the forward pass
get_model_no_weights: create a Detectron2 model from a config YAML file without loading pretrained weights
test_flop_with_output_shape: run flop_count_operators with height and width output shape hints to verify FLOP counts
